page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized bare-metal server powered by 128 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server incorporates 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The underlying hardware runs on a KVM hypervisor foundation and offers a dedicated baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

The hardware configuration includes no integrated local storage and features no discrete GPU accelerators. All persistent storage requirements rely on external network-attached volumes, utilizing the 64 Gbps network interface for remote block storage and inter-node data exchange. This design separates compute and memory density from persistent physical drives.

With its 8:1 memory-to-core ratio and dedicated non-virtualized core architecture, this server type provides substantial hardware capacity for workloads with extensive working sets. The hardware profile is suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, high-capacity distributed caching, complex analytics engines, and memory-constrained enterprise applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized ECS Bare Metal instance equipped with 128 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM, the configuration includes 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators, delegating data persistence to external storage networks facilitated by a 64 Gbps baseline network throughput. The high memory density combined with dedicated bare-metal compute resources is engineered for memory-intensive workloads that demand massive working datasets and stable multi-core processing. Representative applications for this server profile include large in-memory databases, real-time analytics engines, in-memory caches, and enterprise transactional platforms.
